title: Package Manifest
description: The ordered software recipe for one image baseline. An image recipe, not deployment policy: it carries no assignments, schedules, audience targeting, update channels, or dependency resolution.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Incremented when a change is not backward compatible.

id.description: Stable identifier for the package within this manifest.

version.description: Exact version. Rejected: moving references (latest, newest, current, stable, head, any) case-insensitively; and any version where a whole segment is x or X, in any position, which covers the common range dialects. A segment merely starting with x, such as x64, is accepted. Case-insensitivity uses character classes rather than an inline flag, because inline flags are not portable across JSON Schema implementations.

source.description: Exact source reference, relative to the qualified source root. Only the file scheme is resolvable in this schema version. Dot segments are rejected here so a traversing reference is refused when the manifest is validated, not when it is resolved.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256, established before build runtime. Never computed at runtime and then treated as expected.

order.description: Deterministic ordering key. Must be unique within the manifest.

required.description: Whether qualification failure for this package fails the build.
